why: The shopper asked for the best 12V split-phase inverter, and ChatGPT answered with competing single units (a SunGoldPower 4000W card, an Outbound Power 4000W card, and a Victron MultiPlus-II card); its mention of a battery bank, cables and overcurrent protection is an installation caveat, not a set it told the shopper to buy. The deciding fact is single-product: does the unit make true 120/240V split phase from 12V? A single MultiPlus-II 2x120V does not, and at 4,000W a 12V unit draws about 370A. So the page should compare inverters and recommend one, not sell a kit.
